competitors.name: Incredifulls / Kroger
competitors.action: Incredifulls, the frozen-handheld brand formerly centered on The Pizza Cupcake, launched two PAW Patrol PB&J Cups nationwide across the Kroger family of stores. The strawberry-jam and grape-jelly varieties use the brand's sourdough-brioche cup format, carry a suggested retail price of $5.99 to $6.99, and are positioned for thawed or oven/air-fryer preparation.

trends.topic: Pizza-born frozen brands expanding into licensed, portable sourdough handhelds
trends.magnitude: Two PB&J varieties launched across Kroger banners nationwide at a suggested $5.99 to $6.99; Kroger's live product page listed the strawberry variety at $5.99 when checked Oct. 8.
trends.context: This is a brand announcement, and local availability can vary, but Kroger's live listing corroborates the product and shelf price. The strategic signal is direct: a brand built around a pizza-format innovation is using the same sourdough-brioche platform, licensed characters and multiple preparation modes to win lunch, snack and on-the-go occasions beyond pizza. Real Dough should treat portable sourdough formats as freezer-space competition and as evidence that its crust equity could support disciplined adjacencies.

market_data.metric: Incredifulls PAW Patrol PB&J frozen-handheld rollout
market_data.value: Two four-count varieties across the Kroger family of stores nationwide; suggested retail price $5.99 to $6.99
market_data.change: Incredifulls expanded its sourdough-brioche platform beyond Pizza Cupcakes into licensed PB&J handhelds at Kroger banners including Mariano's and Roundy's

breaking.headline: Incredifulls PAW Patrol PB&J Cups Launch Nationwide at Kroger
